description: Latest snapshot of (1) the weekend gap of tokenized US stocks vs a Fri 16:00 ET reference (Hyperliquid oracle, or token last-hour avg; each row's reference_source says which; not the official close), as a volume-weighted consensus across issuers (Ondo, xStocks, bStocks, Remora, Robinhood, Coinbase...) with cross-issuer dispersion and the matching Hyperliquid HIP-3 stock-perp gap; and (2) cross-venue funding APR for the same stock perps. All gaps in basis points vs that Fri 16:00 ET reference. Read-only, free, no key. Thin weekend liquidity; not advice.

limit.description: Max rows per table (default: all rows).

ticker.description: Optional US ticker filter, e.g. NVDA. Case-insensitive.
